active.title: Memory canon v7: canonical memory ADR-gated whole, product memory reconciled from git diff
active.description: Operator grill ruling 2026-09-22 (Q1..Q11). TECHSTACK.md merges into ARCHITECTURE.md as a short Tech Stack section (8-15 lines, one per technology); ARCHITECTURE.md and QUALITY.md lose the Part 1/Part 2 split and are ADR-gated as a whole (text rewrites only in audits or on explicit operator order); the one-decider table and the doctor class diagram leave ARCHITECTURE.md. product/ is the only release-mutable tier: every atom declares sources (path globs), catalog.json carries them, memory.py drift --since <sha> lists atoms whose sources changed and packages no atom covers; closure reconciles in the order delete, update, add and records one structured kind: memory log entry via release.py memory, which refuses an uncovered worklist; a doctor rule makes the candidate PR red until the entry exists; MEM-NARRATIVE-1 (ERROR) forbids dates, release/candidate/task ids and history words in memory; specs_pattern_version 7 with a specs upgrade lane that merges a consumer TECHSTACK.md and deletes it; PILLAR-MEMORY becomes scored over memory.py drift. The candidate's own closure is the first reconciliation of all 23 atoms plus the uncovered packages; brand-identity is deleted.
active.provenance: operator grill 2026-09-22; audit report Fechamento 0.4.7 §4 (15/23 atoms stale, 38 narrative lines, 7 uncovered packages)
